registration_timing: after D3b frozen-dev outcomes and author-side option-A approval, before any official-evaluator score, new ablation score, or controlled cost measurement
purpose: Complete non-search evidence required for the GovReport-centered IEEE Access claim without reopening method selection.

E1_published_evaluator.question: Does the GovReport conclusion survive the dataset authors' released preprocessing and original Perl ROUGE protocol?

authoritative_source.paper: Huang et al., Efficient Attentions for Long Document Summarization, NAACL 2021
authoritative_source.tokenization: stanza Pipeline(lang='en', processors='tokenize,mwt'); tokens joined by spaces and sentences by newlines

E1_published_evaluator.execution: Evaluate the already-frozen 681-row outputs; no summarizer rerun and no system selection. Version the adapter and record Perl ROUGE, pyrouge, Stanza model, Java/Perl, OS, input SHA, and output SHA.
E1_published_evaluator.comparison: Report official corpus scores, per-row official scores when technically valid, absolute deltas from the internal evaluator, and system ranking under both protocols.
E1_published_evaluator.decision_rule: The official protocol becomes manuscript-authoritative. If proposed no longer exceeds the preregistered SBERT+MMR lambda-0.9 comparator on the unweighted macro of R1/R2/RL, or any component becomes clearly negative under paired inference, revoke the GovReport superiority claim; do not change the method or evaluator.

E2_cost_scaling.question: What are the end-to-end cold/warm cost and memory scaling of the frozen proposed system and its relevant comparators?

sample.reference_blind_rule: Compute source sentence counts only. At the q10, q50, and q90 log1p(sentence-count) targets, select the 10 closest unique rows per target; ties use canonical ID. Freeze the resulting 30 IDs before any timing.

states.cold: fresh process, empty task-specific embedding cache, model load and all preprocessing included
states.warm_cache: fresh process, byte-verified populated embedding cache, all non-cache setup included

E2_cost_scaling.replication: 3 measured repetitions per system/state after one discarded instrumentation smoke; deterministic selected indices must be identical across repetitions
E2_cost_scaling.environment: Primary report uses the frozen CPU device protocol. Optional GPU numbers require a separate selected-index equivalence check and are supplementary only.
measurements: peak process-tree RSS sampled at no more than 50 ms
peak GPU allocated/reserved memory when applicable
source words, sentences, sections, candidate count, selected count
E2_cost_scaling.scaling_analysis: Report medians/IQRs by q10/q50/q90 stratum and descriptive log-log slopes versus source words and source sentences. No cost threshold promotes a new method.
E2_cost_scaling.failure_rule: A selected-index mismatch, unverified cache state, overlapping timed jobs, or missing peak-memory trace invalidates that repetition and must be preserved as failed evidence rather than silently discarded.

E3_route_and_provenance_ablation.question: Do non-lexical routes and route provenance contribute under the frozen GovReport configuration?
E3_route_and_provenance_ablation.anchor: C01 full routes + weighted RRF + TF-IDF MMR lambda 0.7

variants.A01_no_semantic: lexical + graph, route_top_k=40 each, total=80; every other frozen setting unchanged
variants.A02_no_graph: lexical + semantic, route_top_k=40 each, total=80; every other frozen setting unchanged
variants.A03_lexical_only_capacity_80: lexical only with route_top_k=80 and total=80; explicit capacity-matched route ablation
variants.A04_equal_rank_rrf: reuse each row's exact full C01 candidate pool; recompute selector salience with equal route weights and no quality-directed tuning
variants.A05_index_only_lexical: reuse each row's exact full C01 candidate pool; selector receives normalized lexical importance only and ignores route membership/agreement/fusion

diagnostics: actual summary words and selected sentences
candidate pool size and route proposals
route unique candidates and unique selected sentences
metric-specific greedy-reference recall as a reference-aware diagnostic only
wall time and peak process-tree RSS
E3_route_and_provenance_ablation.inference: Five anchor-versus-ablation paired comparisons x four quality endpoints = Holm family of 20; 100,000 paired bootstrap resamples, base seed 20260820. All-row denominator; infeasible rows remain.

claim_rules.semantic_quality_contribution: full minus A01 macro must be positive with 95% CI lower >0 and Holm-20 p<=0.05
claim_rules.graph_quality_contribution: full minus A02 macro must be positive with 95% CI lower >0 and Holm-20 p<=0.05
claim_rules.combined_nonlexical_contribution: full minus A03 macro must be positive with 95% CI lower >0 and Holm-20 p<=0.05
claim_rules.provenance_contribution: full must beat both A04 and A05 on macro with CI lower >0 and Holm-20 p<=0.05
claim_rules.failure: Downgrade the unsupported component claim; do not create another weight, route, budget, or selector search.

global_stop_rule: After E1-E3, write a freeze audit. No outcome authorizes another dev grid or any dev-test/test access. If E1 reverses the primary comparison, the quality-superiority route is No-Go even if E2/E3 are favorable.
